dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (As an Honorary Knight, I cannot stand idly by!)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then... Sorry, but we have no choice, Miss Jala!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Please understand, as you've unintentionally caused significant damage and violated the laws of Mondstadt... We have no choice but to do this!

dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: Huh? What are you talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: Wait... Why are you getting ready for a fight... Are you going hunting?

dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: No need! No need at all! I still have lots of food here...

dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: Waaaaaah!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Hehe, Dodoco defeated lots of bad Spikey Fish Warriors! Even the Spikey Fish King was no match!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Dodoco, Jumpy Dumpty, and Klee's Sparks 'n' Splash are the best!

choices.text: Truly unstoppable!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This game reminds Paimon of the incident happening in Cider Lake... Did Lisa base its theme on that?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But come to think of it, why go to the trouble of finding the invading species when they could just ask Klee to blow up every suspicious fish?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: They could even give us some bombs and let us handle this!

choices.text: You and Klee are like two peas in a pod.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Well well, from the looks on your faces, it seems like you're having fun.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: It's Lisa!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're here!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We loved playing Dodoco's Bomb-Tastic Adventure! What a fun game you designed!

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Thanks for playing, I'm glad you enjoyed it. Hmm, perhaps I should come up with some new updates?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Oooh, yay! Klee wants to see Dodoco going on adventures in all kinds of places!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: No, wait... You must've spent a looong time working on the game, it must be exhausting! We shouldn't make Lisa work too hard...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Aw, thank you for being so considerate.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: But if it helps keep you happy while you stay inside the city, I'll be more than happy to spend as much time as needed.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Of course, I understand that you prefer going on your own adventures whenever you like. The game is just meant to be a new way to pass the time.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Anyway, I have some great news, and I've also brought a gift for you, cuties.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: A gift!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: #Actually, I have a gift for {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Honorary Knight and Paimon, too!

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: We'll get to the gifts in a moment, let me tell you the news first.

choices.text: Is the incident in Cider Lake resolved?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: That's right. Two Knights from the Investigation Team found the invasive species' nest and swiftly disposed of it.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: The Knights have also determined the cause of their invasion.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: The species were accidentally introduced to the lake by a merchant without any malicious intent, so the Knights let her go after some lecturing and issuing a fine.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Phew... Luckily they didn't cause too much trouble. But even Paimon thinks that merchant was way too careless!

choices.text: The water in Cider Lake is safe!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Is it time for gifts yet? Can Klee go first?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Of course.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Klee's been returning home on time every day without being reminded by anyone, so I've been wondering what you're up to lately...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Hehe~

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: When I was home at night, I looked through Albedo's crafting book and learned to make this!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Tada!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, it's Dodoco throwing a Jumpy Dumpty!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yep! I made a figure that looks like the Dodoco from Dodoco's Bomb-Tastic Adventure!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Even though I can't make it throw real bombs...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I hope it'll remind you of the fun we had together and blast away your troubles and boredom!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A big Dodoco toy! Paimon loves surprises like this!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: With this, it'll feel like we're adventuring with Klee and Dodoco wherever we go!

choices.text: Thank you for the creative and thoughtful gift, Klee!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Hehe, I'm so happy you like my gift! I worked super hard on it!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: What's your gift, Lisa? I wanna see!

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Well, I'm afraid my gift is a lot less creative than yours.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: It's a storybook about Dodoco's Bomb-Tastic Adventures—

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: An adventure story! Yay!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, a whole storybook!

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: The little cuties returned to Mondstadt and joined Klee on an adventure with Dodoco!

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Together they defeated the bad Spikey Fish Warriors and then enjoyed an afternoon tea...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: A most fitting way to end Dodoco's Bomb-Tastic Adventure.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Did you plan out the whole story while designing the game?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: No. As the protagonists of the story, you, little cutie, and Klee all played an important part in bringing the story to life.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: I've left a blank spot in the book specially for illustrations...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: But I just thought of an even better idea — since we're all here on this special occasion, why don't I take a photo of you together?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sure! We got to see our friends and play games together, that's definitely worth celebrating!

choices.text: Let's take a group photo!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: #C'mon then, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Honorary Knight and Paimon! Ready, Lisa?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Klee had so much fun today! Three, two, one... Dodoco!

choices.text: You gotta treasure the small joys in life!
Dodoco will come with us on all our adventures from now on!
Mondstadt's wine industry is safe!
Can Klee play outside again?
Nope, no bombs for Paimon.
Take that, bad fish!

dialogues.speaker: Porthos
dialogues.text: Oh, Honorary Knight and The Helper in White, you are truly impressive, capturing the fugitive just like that!

dialogues.speaker: Porthos
dialogues.text: When my colleague and I first identified her as a suspect, after we confirmed her identity and time of departure, we mistakenly predicted she had fled in the direction of Dornman Port... We were just about to go after her on a ship...

dialogues.speaker: Porthos
dialogues.text: We didn't expect her to be hiding deep inside the Brightcrown Mountains. No wonder we couldn't track her down... She sure has some excellent counter-surveillance skills!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Paimon doesn't think she tried to evade you at all... She didn't even know what happened...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nevertheless, Jala did make a big mistake, but she never meant for any of it to happen. Please don't be too harsh on her!

dialogues.speaker: Porthos
dialogues.text: Of course! I heard she's been quite cooperative. When criminals are cooperative, we will also be calm and rational when dealing with them.

dialogues.speaker: Porthos
dialogues.text: The investigation team reports that the current situation can be managed. We just need to go through the standard procedures, assess the damages, and then fine her accordingly.

choices.text: That'll be enough punishment.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whew... Didn't think we would take part in this incident... So this is what it feels like to capture a criminal as a knight!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, it's a relief that Jala was just careless and not trying to sabotage Mondstadt's wine industry...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If we had caught a vicious, super noisy criminal who had no remorse, it would really have spoiled our good mood!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon hopes Jala has learned her lesson and won't be too upset about her punishment...

choices.text: She's not a bad person, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: Oh, how relaxing! The forests of Mondstadt are indeed a great place for camping! This business trip is so worth it!

dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: The humidity and temperature are just perfect, so my clothes won't get drenched in sweat whenever I try to do a bit of work. The sunlight is not too glaring, and there's even a nice fragrance in the air!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You are?

dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: Oh! New friends! Please, sit! Have some tea, let's eat and chat together!

dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: I'm Jala. I'm a merchant from Sumeru. I just closed a big deal, and right now, I'm enjoying the natural beauty of Mondstadt!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's the first time we've met someone camping in this area...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shouldn't a merchant be... guarding their shop and cargo? If you hadn't told us, we would never have guessed what you are!

dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: Oh, merchants are people too, we also need rest. Who doesn't have a few hobbies? Work-life balance, you know, work-life balance...

dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: You know, back in Sumeru, even students tormented by their studies all the time value this. They even invent games to help themselves relax!

dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: I earned my first big haul by distributing a tabletop game invented by a student, called Shroomsplosion!

dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: That genius student once said, "There's always more work. One must learn to take some time to... take a break~".

dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: She brought me wealth beyond my wildest imagination, so I took her words as my motto! Sure enough, I live happily every day!

choices.text: That name sounds oddly familiar...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: J—Jala! Can you tell us more about how you came to distribute that "Shroomsplosion" game?

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: Huh? You've also heard of it? It's already a really old game... Was it years or over a decade ago? Oh, how time flies...

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: It was quite a coincidence, really. At the time, she was going to return to her homeland, so she sold everything she couldn't bring with her, including the game's pieces and board.

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: Back then I bought and sold junk and secondhand goods. When I had the fortune to run into her, I asked her about the pieces, and it reminded her that the game she invented may still be of some use... So she briefly walked me through it...

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: She said, if I was willing, I could try to keep the game running. I made a few copies, and they sold really well! My income just boom! Exploded upward!

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: Though Shroomsplosion didn't stay popular for long and was replaced by other similar games, it did earn me enough capital to start a real business. I no longer had to rely on selling junk to make a living.

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: You could say that the unintentional act of a student genius changed my life!

choices.text: Could it really be a coincidence!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now that Paimon thinks about it, it does seem like something she would do... Perhaps she actually invented quite a few games, and "Shroomsplosion" just wasn't that important to her?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Or, in terms of business, she probably felt managing the rights of the games was really troublesome... She probably couldn't be bothered with it and felt her time worth more than the Mora she'd earn.

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: Right? Don't you think it was amazing?

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: Later, I heard that her home was Mondstadt, and since then, Mondstadt has become one of my favorite places to go!

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: So, for many years, I've been trying to find the chance to finally come to Mondstadt to do business and see what the culture and people are like for myself!

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: I have to say, it didn't disappoint! I closed a big deal and had a great time here!

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: I sincerely suggest you trying it for yourselves. Find a good work-life balance, and give your life a comfortable rhythm!

choices.text: Just giving away her creation like that!?
The student you're talking about wouldn't happen to be...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Business?

dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: Oh? You're locals? Want to join me for a cup of soup or some food?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How hospitable! Are you a... camping enthusiast?

dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: Ha! Well, you wouldn't be completely wrong to say that! I'm Jala, a merchant from Sumeru. Perhaps you'll become familiar with my name soon.

dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: Once I get approval, you'll be able to purchase my goods from Miss Blanche! I offer unique Sumeru ingredients, spices, and tableware, all at a fair price!

dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: I have to say, Mondstadters are so amicable. We reached an agreement really fast without much haggling!

dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: Not that the people in Sumeru are bad-tempered... We just tend to care more about details... and would spend quite a long time negotiating prices for bulk orders...

choices.text: There must be straight-forward people in Sumeru, too!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah. There are all kinds of people everywhere! You can't generalize about people like that!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Maybe your past business deals didn't go so smoothly because of bad luck. But this time in Mondstadt, maybe you just got lucky?

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: Got lucky?

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: Right! When I first got to Mondstadt, I released a few fish for luck... That must be what brought me luck and led me to my ideal business partner!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You released... a few fish?

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: That's right! Since it feels like we are bound by destiny, let me tell you a secret I learned from merchants in Fontaine that only a few people from Sumeru know...

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: Before doing something important, release some animals into the wild. It will bring you good fortune! Some even buy animals just to release them!

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: If you are hunters or something like that, you can consider doing it too! You lose a few Mora in exchange for lots of good luck! It's really a good deal!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #(Hey, {NICKNAME}... The sudden appearance of Anglers in Cider Lake... Do you think it's because of...)

choices.text: (This merchant is the culprit...)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (She's completely oblivious to the mess she made... So? Should we tell her? After all, it's already gotten really serious!)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Or should we just arrest her on the spot and let the Knights of Favonius decide her fate?)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Hm... Such a difficult decision! It feels like she's a warm-hearted person, and she was just trying to be hospitable to us... Turning on her now makes it feel like we're the bad guys here...)

choices.text: (How careless could she be...)
There must be business-savvy Mondstadters, too!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (She's enjoying her leisure time. Let's not disturb her...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Good point. People who make camp in secluded places like this prefer their privacy... Let's just leave.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (I really don't want to arrogate the authority to myself...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Arrogate? What's with that weird term, all of a sudden? Paimon thinks she's heard it before somewhere...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Do you mean, arresting suspects is a responsibility of other knights? We cannot do some other knight's job... and steal the credit?)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Hmm... It does make sense! Although Jala committed a crime, she doesn't seem like a bad person... Even a regular knight could apprehend her easily.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (For regular knights, this is an opportunity to acquire some easy merit. It really doesn't matter to us. We should just let them take care of it...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (But Jala is in a very secluded location. The knights might not be able to locate her easily... We have to get Jala back to Mondstadt somehow.)

dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: What are you whispering about? Are you also interested in the theory behind releasing animals for luck?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! We... We heard you talking about fish, so we're wondering what we should have for dinner!

choices.text: I find myself suddenly craving some grilled fish.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Hm... Oh! Right, right, right!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Since you are here in Mondstadt, you gotta try Mondstadt Grilled Fish! It's so fragrant and convenient! Oh, and also Sticky Honey Roast, "Pile 'Em Up," and Flaming Red Bolognese!

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: Oh! You just reminded me of something!

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: I was so focused on my business deal and taking a scenic tour of Mondstadt that I completely forgot to enjoy some nice local specialties!

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: I heard there's a restaurant called Good Hunter in Mondstadt that offers great food at a good price and even provides delivery services! So I placed a few days' worth of orders without giving it much thought...

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: But I forgot to ask about local specialties at that time, and the deliveryperson may not be able to find where I set up camp...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Say, why not just go back to Mondstadt and enjoy a good meal?

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: Right! I'll also ask the locals about other Mondstadt specialties to take back with me as souvenirs for my friends!

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: If I remember correctly, there are two knights stationed by the gates. They should be quite knowledgeable of Mondstadt and could give me some good recommendations!

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: You know what? I'm going back right now!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Jala leaves the campsite with enthusiasm, heading back toward Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Jala even suggested talking to the knights herself... Paimon wonders if she'll get arrested on the spot...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But perhaps the knights will understand that her actions were unintentional... No one who deliberately caused trouble would willingly come to talk to the knights, right?

choices.text: Jala likely won't be punished severely.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Paimon still feels bad about this, but people have to take responsiblity for their mistakes!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon only hopes Jala realizes her mistake soon and won't get too upset after being punished...

choices.text: We solved the problem peacefully.
Have you ever had Mondstadt Grilled Fish?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Before Jala can react, you and Paimon charge at her and knock her out with just the right amount of force, before putting her on your shoulders and carrying her back to the Knights of Favonius headquarters...
